title: Post-Hospital Visits after Inpatient Care — Primary Care Provider Assignment
content:
**Bulletin: post-hospital visits on standing referrals under the Primary Care Provider Assignment.**

Post-hospital visits are added to a standing referral's allowance for recent inpatient care, before the standing-referral visit ceiling is applied. They are counted as the member's paid inpatient-stay claims — claims in the inpatient stay category booked on the member's **Medicaid Managed Care Membership** — with a service date in the hospital look-back window of **12 months**:

- **2 or more** stays add the larger post-hospital allowance of **4** visits;
- exactly **1** stay adds the smaller post-hospital allowance of **2** visits;
- no stay adds nothing.

The hospital look-back window is a trailing period counted back from the handling date in whole months: a claim is inside it when fewer than 12 whole months separate its service date from the handling date, so a claim dated exactly 12 months back is outside it.

| Paid inpatient-stay claims in the last 12 months | Post-hospital visits added |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0 |
| 1 | 2 |
| 2 | 4 |
| 3 | 4 |

**Hypothetical members, handling date 15 September 2026**

- Paid inpatient-stay claims with service dates 2 January 2026 and 30 July 2026: two stays, 4 post-hospital visits.
- Paid inpatient-stay claims with service dates 15 September 2025 and 30 July 2026: the first is exactly 12 months back and outside; one stay, 2 post-hospital visits.
- An inpatient-stay claim that was denied rather than paid does not count.
